history.message: Write a Python script to scrape a website
history.reply:
Sure! Here's a basic Python script to scrape a website using `requests` and `BeautifulSoup`:

```python
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

url = "https://example.com"
response = requests.get(url)
soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, "html.parser")

# Example: Get title
title = soup.title.string
print("Title:", title)

# Example: Get all links
for link in soup.find_all("a"):
    print(link.get("href"))
```
